_comment: Source of truth for deck-legality formats. Baked into the Rust engine via include_str! (compile-time) and read at runtime by the hosted API. Edit this file to change banlists, the EDEN anomaly protocol, or to add a format -- no Rust/Python code change required. See docs/EDEN_FORMAT_RULES.md and the add-deck-format-registry change. card_kind: digimon|tamer|option|digi-egg. rarities use printed codes: C U R SR SEC P.

eden._source: Digimon Card Game EDEN Format Rules & Guidance, version 1.1.1, 18/01/2025. EX02-007 normalized to EX2-007.

anomaly_protocol._comment: EDEN Anomaly Protocol: rare-or-higher cards are illegal in EDEN UNLESS they match a category below or appear in extra_card_ids, and the deck holds at most max_total such cards. Expand by adding a category or appending card IDs to extra_card_ids.

formats.name: Standard
formats.description: The official ruleset: 50-card decks and the current ENG banlist.

formats.name: No Banlist
formats.description: Standard shape with every card legal -- no banned or restricted list.

formats.name: Pauper
formats.description: Common and uncommon cards only, on the standard ENG banlist.

formats.name: EDEN
formats.description: Common/uncommon plus the EDEN Anomaly Protocol (up to 4 rare/promo Tamers, Memory Boosts, Training, and Scramble options), on EDEN's custom banlist.

formats.name: EDEN Singleton
formats.description: EDEN's card pool and banlist, played highlander: at most one copy of any card.

formats.name: Starter
formats.description: The six official starter decks (ST-1..ST-6), played with no banlist so the as-printed ST-2 deck (ST2-13 x4) is legal.
